description: This file defines the RetrieveFeatureProperty class, a command object in the Ditto framework that retrieves a feature's property from a Thing. It includes methods for constructing the command, parsing from JSON, and serializing to JSON, along with relevant fields and identifiers.

classes.name: RetrieveFeatureProperty
classes.description: An immutable command class that retrieves a feature's property from a Thing, supporting JSON serialization and deserialization.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory methods to create instances of RetrieveFeatureProperty with either String or ThingId for the Thing identification.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a RetrieveFeatureProperty instance from a JSON string or JSON object.

methods.name: getPropertyPointer
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer for the property to retrieve.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the Thing entity.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the feature.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer representing the resource path to the property.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Serializes the command fields into a JSON object based on the schema version.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the provided DittoHeaders.
